messages:
olivia: Quickpatch queued — we need an expedited deploy to eu1 inference pool. Tokenizer path regressed on canary. Patch v1.2.7 ready, recommend pinning tokenizer image and skipping full canary rollout. Change window: now → 21:00 UTC.

cheng: oncall ok with expedited flow, but we need explicit rollback criteria and a pinned image sha. share sha and rollout steps pls.

mike: +1 from runtime. Verified unit tests and short perf microbench. give me 10 to sanity-check metrics.

deploy-bot: New deploy request created by @olivia: deploy/quickpatch-eu1-1858501234. Canary target: 10% traffic, 5m observation.

olivia: Rollback criteria: error-rate +5% absolute or latency p95 +200ms sustained >5m triggers immediate rollback. Also revert route to fallback-model variant.

cheng: Pinned container sha: `sha256:3a7b9f8c2d1f4e6b9c0d5e2a7f4b1c9e6d2a8c3b9f0e1d2c3b4a5f6e7d8c9b0`. Apply with:
```
kubectl set image deploy/llm-infer tokenizer=registry.redwood/llm-tokenizer:1.2.7-3a7b9f8 --namespace=eu1
```

tara: Approved from product side — regression affects several customers. Recommend increasing canary to 25% if no signals after 10m, else rollback.

oncall-bot: Oncall alerting configured, prometheus alerts for `tokenizer_errors_total` and `llm_p95_latency` will page on threshold.

mike: Observing canary now. metrics look stable at +1m. No error spike.

olivia: moving to 25% canary per tara.

deploy-bot: Canary update: 10% -> 25% (deploy/quickpatch-eu1-1858501234). Observation window extended 10m.

mike: 10m in, p95 +60ms, errors flat. Proceeding to full rollout unless objections.

cheng: No objections. I'm staying available for rollback.

olivia: Final check: release notes link: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/1.2.7-quickpatch — includes minimal changelog and mitigation steps. Tagging support for FYI.

deploy-bot: Full rollout initiated: 25% -> 100%. Version pinned to `1.2.7-3a7b9f8`.

oncall-bot: No pages in 6m post-rollout. Health checks green.

olivia: Marking as expedited-approved by eng and oncall. Will open a short post-deploy ticket for follow-up and cost telemetry. :thumbsup:

mike: thanks everyone. Closing thread.
